faq_heading: New construction in Downtown New Westminster: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in Downtown New Westminster sold for?
faq.a: 133 condos sold in Downtown New Westminster at a median of $519,900, with the middle half between $450,000 and $593,500.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Downtown New Westminster?
faq.a: Condos in Downtown New Westminster took 23 days at a median to sell.

faq.q: Which homes in Downtown New Westminster are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Downtown New Westminster, condos had the newest median build year, 2007.
